(vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo.description: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) is one of the most common causes of vertigo — the sudden sensation that you're spinning or that the inside of your head is spinning. Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo causes brief episodes of mild to intense dizziness.
(vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo.search_content:
Disease: (vertigo) Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo
Medical Overview: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) is one of the most common causes of vertigo — the sudden sensation that you're spinning or that the inside of your head is spinning. Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo causes brief episodes of mild to intense dizziness.
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, headache, nausea, spinning movements, loss of balance, unsteadiness
Recommended Precautions & Management: lie down; avoid sudden change in body; avoid abrupt head movment; relax
Recommended Specialist: ENT Specialist / Neurologist

AIDS.description: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). By damaging your immune system, HIV interferes with your body's ability to fight infection and disease.
AIDS.search_content:
Disease: AIDS
Medical Overview: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). By damaging your immune system, HIV interferes with your body's ability to fight infection and disease.
Hallmark Symptoms: muscle wasting, patches in throat, high fever, extra marital contacts
Recommended Precautions & Management: avoid open cuts; wear ppe if possible; consult doctor; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Infectious Disease Specialist

Acne.description: Acne vulgaris is the formation of comedones, papules, pustules, nodules, and/or cysts as a result of obstruction and inflammation of pilosebaceous units (hair follicles and their accompanying sebaceous gland). Acne develops on the face and upper trunk. It most often affects adolescents.
Acne.search_content:
Disease: Acne
Medical Overview: Acne vulgaris is the formation of comedones, papules, pustules, nodules, and/or cysts as a result of obstruction and inflammation of pilosebaceous units (hair follicles and their accompanying sebaceous gland). Acne develops on the face and upper trunk. It most often affects adolescents.
Hallmark Symptoms: skin rash, pus filled pimples, blackheads, scurring
Recommended Precautions & Management: bath twice; avoid fatty spicy food; drink plenty of water; avoid too many products
Recommended Specialist: Dermatologist

Alcoholic Hepatitis.description: Alcoholic hepatitis is a diseased, inflammatory condition of the liver caused by heavy alcohol consumption over an extended period of time. It's also aggravated by binge drinking and ongoing alcohol use. If you develop this condition, you must stop drinking alcohol
Alcoholic Hepatitis.search_content:
Disease: Alcoholic Hepatitis
Medical Overview: Alcoholic hepatitis is a diseased, inflammatory condition of the liver caused by heavy alcohol consumption over an extended period of time. It's also aggravated by binge drinking and ongoing alcohol use. If you develop this condition, you must stop drinking alcohol
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, yellowish skin, abdominal pain, swelling of stomach, distention of abdomen, history of alcohol consumption, fluid overload.1
Recommended Precautions & Management: stop alcohol consumption; consult doctor; medication; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Allergy.description: An allergy is an immune system response to a foreign substance that's not typically harmful to your body.They can include certain foods, pollen, or pet dander. Your immune system's job is to keep you healthy by fighting harmful pathogens.
Allergy.search_content:
Disease: Allergy
Medical Overview: An allergy is an immune system response to a foreign substance that's not typically harmful to your body.They can include certain foods, pollen, or pet dander. Your immune system's job is to keep you healthy by fighting harmful pathogens.
Hallmark Symptoms: continuous sneezing, shivering, chills, watering from eyes
Recommended Precautions & Management: apply calamine; cover area with bandage; use ice to compress itching
Recommended Specialist: Allergist

Arthritis.description: Arthritis is the swelling and tenderness of one or more of your joints. The main symptoms of arthritis are joint pain and stiffness, which typically worsen with age. The most common types of arthritis are osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis.
Arthritis.search_content:
Disease: Arthritis
Medical Overview: Arthritis is the swelling and tenderness of one or more of your joints. The main symptoms of arthritis are joint pain and stiffness, which typically worsen with age. The most common types of arthritis are osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis.
Hallmark Symptoms: muscle weakness, stiff neck, swelling joints, movement stiffness, painful walking
Recommended Precautions & Management: exercise; use hot and cold therapy; try acupuncture; massage
Recommended Specialist: Rheumatologist

Bronchial Asthma.description: Bronchial asthma is a medical condition which causes the airway path of the lungs to swell and narrow. Due to this swelling, the air path produces excess mucus making it hard to breathe, which results in coughing, short breath, and wheezing. The disease is chronic and interferes with daily working.
Bronchial Asthma.search_content:
Disease: Bronchial Asthma
Medical Overview: Bronchial asthma is a medical condition which causes the airway path of the lungs to swell and narrow. Due to this swelling, the air path produces excess mucus making it hard to breathe, which results in coughing, short breath, and wheezing. The disease is chronic and interferes with daily working.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, cough, high fever, breathlessness, family history, mucoid sputum
Recommended Precautions & Management: switch to loose cloothing; take deep breaths; get away from trigger; seek help
Recommended Specialist: Pulmonologist

Cervical Spondylosis.description: Cervical spondylosis is a general term for age-related wear and tear affecting the spinal disks in your neck. As the disks dehydrate and shrink, signs of osteoarthritis develop, including bony projections along the edges of bones (bone spurs).
precautions: use heating pad or cold pack
Cervical Spondylosis.search_content:
Disease: Cervical Spondylosis
Medical Overview: Cervical spondylosis is a general term for age-related wear and tear affecting the spinal disks in your neck. As the disks dehydrate and shrink, signs of osteoarthritis develop, including bony projections along the edges of bones (bone spurs).
Hallmark Symptoms: back pain, weakness in limbs, neck pain, dizziness, loss of balance
Recommended Precautions & Management: use heating pad or cold pack; exercise; take otc pain reliver; consult doctor
Recommended Specialist: Orthopedist / Neurologist

Chicken Pox.description: Chickenpox is a highly contagious disease caused by the varicella-zoster virus (VZV). It can cause an itchy, blister-like rash. The rash first appears on the chest, back, and face, and then spreads over the entire body, causing between 250 and 500 itchy blisters.
Chicken Pox.search_content:
Disease: Chicken Pox
Medical Overview: Chickenpox is a highly contagious disease caused by the varicella-zoster virus (VZV). It can cause an itchy, blister-like rash. The rash first appears on the chest, back, and face, and then spreads over the entire body, causing between 250 and 500 itchy blisters.
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, skin rash, fatigue, lethargy, high fever, headache, loss of appetite, mild fever, swelled lymph nodes, malaise, red spots over body
Recommended Precautions & Management: use neem in bathing; consume neem leaves; take vaccine; avoid public places
Recommended Specialist: General Physician / Dermatologist

Chronic Cholestasis.description: Chronic cholestatic diseases, whether occurring in infancy, childhood or adulthood, are characterized by defective bile acid transport from the liver to the intestine, which is caused by primary damage to the biliary epithelium in most cases
Chronic Cholestasis.search_content:
Disease: Chronic Cholestasis
Medical Overview: Chronic cholestatic diseases, whether occurring in infancy, childhood or adulthood, are characterized by defective bile acid transport from the liver to the intestine, which is caused by primary damage to the biliary epithelium in most cases
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, vomiting, yellowish skin, nausea, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, yellowing of eyes
Recommended Precautions & Management: cold baths; anti itch medicine; consult doctor; eat healthy
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Common Cold.description: The common cold is a viral infection of your nose and throat (upper respiratory tract). It's usually harmless, although it might not feel that way. Many types of viruses can cause a common cold.
Common Cold.search_content:
Disease: Common Cold
Medical Overview: The common cold is a viral infection of your nose and throat (upper respiratory tract). It's usually harmless, although it might not feel that way. Many types of viruses can cause a common cold.
Hallmark Symptoms: continuous sneezing, chills, fatigue, cough, high fever, headache, swelled lymph nodes, malaise, phlegm, throat irritation, redness of eyes, sinus pressure, runny nose, congestion, chest pain, loss of smell, muscle pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: drink vitamin c rich drinks; take vapour; avoid cold food; keep fever in check
Recommended Specialist: General Physician

Dengue.description: an acute infectious disease caused by a flavivirus (species Dengue virus of the genus Flavivirus), transmitted by aedes mosquitoes, and characterized by headache, severe joint pain, and a rash. — called also breakbone fever, dengue fever.
Dengue.search_content:
Disease: Dengue
Medical Overview: an acute infectious disease caused by a flavivirus (species Dengue virus of the genus Flavivirus), transmitted by aedes mosquitoes, and characterized by headache, severe joint pain, and a rash. — called also breakbone fever, dengue fever.
Hallmark Symptoms: skin rash, chills, joint pain, vomiting, fatigue, high fever, headache, nausea, loss of appetite, pain behind the eyes, back pain, malaise, muscle pain, red spots over body
Recommended Precautions & Management: drink papaya leaf juice; avoid fatty spicy food; keep mosquitos away; keep hydrated
Recommended Specialist: Infectious Disease Specialist

Diabetes.description: Diabetes is a disease that occurs when your blood glucose, also called blood sugar, is too high. Blood glucose is your main source of energy and comes from the food you eat. Insulin, a hormone made by the pancreas, helps glucose from food get into your cells to be used for energy.
Diabetes.search_content:
Disease: Diabetes
Medical Overview: Diabetes is a disease that occurs when your blood glucose, also called blood sugar, is too high. Blood glucose is your main source of energy and comes from the food you eat. Insulin, a hormone made by the pancreas, helps glucose from food get into your cells to be used for energy.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, weight loss, restlessness, lethargy, irregular sugar level, blurred and distorted vision, obesity, excessive hunger, increased appetite, polyuria
Recommended Precautions & Management: have balanced diet; exercise; consult doctor; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Endocrinologist

Dimorphic hemorrhoids (piles).description: Hemorrhoids, also spelled haemorrhoids, are vascular structures in the anal canal. In their ... Other names, Haemorrhoids, piles, hemorrhoidal disease .
Dimorphic hemorrhoids (piles).search_content:
Disease: Dimorphic hemorrhoids (piles)
Medical Overview: Hemorrhoids, also spelled haemorrhoids, are vascular structures in the anal canal. In their ... Other names, Haemorrhoids, piles, hemorrhoidal disease .
Hallmark Symptoms: constipation, pain during bowel movements, pain in anal region, bloody stool, irritation in anus
Recommended Precautions & Management: avoid fatty spicy food; consume witch hazel; warm bath with epsom salt; consume alovera juice
Recommended Specialist: General Surgeon / Proctologist

Drug Reaction.description: An adverse drug reaction (ADR) is an injury caused by taking medication. ADRs may occur following a single dose or prolonged administration of a drug or result from the combination of two or more drugs.
Drug Reaction.search_content:
Disease: Drug Reaction
Medical Overview: An adverse drug reaction (ADR) is an injury caused by taking medication. ADRs may occur following a single dose or prolonged administration of a drug or result from the combination of two or more drugs.
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, skin rash, stomach pain, burning micturition, spotting  urination
Recommended Precautions & Management: stop irritation; consult nearest hospital; stop taking drug; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Allergist / Dermatologist

Fungal Infection.description: In humans, fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. Fungi can live in the air, soil, water, and plants. There are also some fungi that live naturally in the human body. Like many microbes, there are helpful fungi and harmful fungi.
precautions: use detol or neem in bathing water
Fungal Infection.search_content:
Disease: Fungal Infection
Medical Overview: In humans, fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. Fungi can live in the air, soil, water, and plants. There are also some fungi that live naturally in the human body. Like many microbes, there are helpful fungi and harmful fungi.
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, skin rash, nodal skin eruptions, dischromic  patches
Recommended Precautions & Management: bath twice; use detol or neem in bathing water; keep infected area dry; use clean cloths
Recommended Specialist: Dermatologist

GERD.description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease, or GERD, is a digestive disorder that affects the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), the ring of muscle between the esophagus and stomach. Many people, including pregnant women, suffer from heartburn or acid indigestion caused by GERD.
GERD.search_content:
Disease: GERD
Medical Overview: Gastroesophageal reflux disease, or GERD, is a digestive disorder that affects the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), the ring of muscle between the esophagus and stomach. Many people, including pregnant women, suffer from heartburn or acid indigestion caused by GERD.
Hallmark Symptoms: stomach pain, acidity, ulcers on tongue, vomiting, cough, chest pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: avoid fatty spicy food; avoid lying down after eating; maintain healthy weight; exercise
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist

Gastroenteritis.description: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the digestive tract, particularly the stomach, and large and small intestines. Viral and bacterial gastroenteritis are intestinal infections associated with symptoms of diarrhea , abdominal cramps, nausea , and vomiting .
precautions: stop eating solid food for while
try taking small sips of water
Gastroenteritis.search_content:
Disease: Gastroenteritis
Medical Overview: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the digestive tract, particularly the stomach, and large and small intestines. Viral and bacterial gastroenteritis are intestinal infections associated with symptoms of diarrhea , abdominal cramps, nausea , and vomiting .
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, sunken eyes, dehydration, diarrhoea
Recommended Precautions & Management: stop eating solid food for while; try taking small sips of water; rest; ease back into eating
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist

Heart Attack.description: The death of heart muscle due to the loss of blood supply. The loss of blood supply is usually caused by a complete blockage of a coronary artery, one of the arteries that supplies blood to the heart muscle.
Heart Attack.search_content:
Disease: Heart Attack
Medical Overview: The death of heart muscle due to the loss of blood supply. The loss of blood supply is usually caused by a complete blockage of a coronary artery, one of the arteries that supplies blood to the heart muscle.
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, breathlessness, sweating, chest pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: call ambulance; chew or swallow asprin; keep calm
Recommended Specialist: Cardiologist

Hepatitis A.description: Hepatitis A is a highly contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus. The virus is one of several types of hepatitis viruses that cause inflammation and affect your liver's ability to function.
Hepatitis A.search_content:
Disease: Hepatitis A
Medical Overview: Hepatitis A is a highly contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus. The virus is one of several types of hepatitis viruses that cause inflammation and affect your liver's ability to function.
Hallmark Symptoms: joint pain, vomiting, yellowish skin, dark urine, nausea, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, mild fever, yellowing of eyes, muscle pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: Consult nearest hospital; wash hands through; avoid fatty spicy food; medication
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Hepatitis B.description: Hepatitis B is an infection of your liver. It can cause scarring of the organ, liver failure, and cancer. It can be fatal if it isn't treated. It's spread when people come in contact with the blood, open sores, or body fluids of someone who has the hepatitis B virus.
Hepatitis B.search_content:
Disease: Hepatitis B
Medical Overview: Hepatitis B is an infection of your liver. It can cause scarring of the organ, liver failure, and cancer. It can be fatal if it isn't treated. It's spread when people come in contact with the blood, open sores, or body fluids of someone who has the hepatitis B virus.
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, fatigue, lethargy, yellowish skin, dark urine, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, yellow urine, yellowing of eyes, malaise, receiving blood transfusion, receiving unsterile injections
Recommended Precautions & Management: consult nearest hospital; vaccination; eat healthy; medication
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Hepatitis C.description: Inflammation of the liver due to the hepatitis C virus (HCV), which is usually spread via blood transfusion (rare), hemodialysis, and needle sticks. The damage hepatitis C does to the liver can lead to cirrhosis and its complications as well as cancer.
Hepatitis C.search_content:
Disease: Hepatitis C
Medical Overview: Inflammation of the liver due to the hepatitis C virus (HCV), which is usually spread via blood transfusion (rare), hemodialysis, and needle sticks. The damage hepatitis C does to the liver can lead to cirrhosis and its complications as well as cancer.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, yellowish skin, nausea, loss of appetite, yellowing of eyes, family history
Recommended Precautions & Management: Consult nearest hospital; vaccination; eat healthy; medication
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Hepatitis D.description: Hepatitis D, also known as the hepatitis delta virus, is an infection that causes the liver to become inflamed. This swelling can impair liver function and cause long-term liver problems, including liver scarring and cancer. The condition is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV).
Hepatitis D.search_content:
Disease: Hepatitis D
Medical Overview: Hepatitis D, also known as the hepatitis delta virus, is an infection that causes the liver to become inflamed. This swelling can impair liver function and cause long-term liver problems, including liver scarring and cancer. The condition is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV).
Hallmark Symptoms: joint pain, vomiting, fatigue, yellowish skin, dark urine, nausea, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, yellowing of eyes
Recommended Precautions & Management: consult doctor; medication; eat healthy; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Hepatitis E.description: A rare form of liver inflammation caused by infection with the hepatitis E virus (HEV). It is transmitted via food or drink handled by an infected person or through infected water supplies in areas where fecal matter may get into the water. Hepatitis E does not cause chronic liver disease.
Hepatitis E.search_content:
Disease: Hepatitis E
Medical Overview: A rare form of liver inflammation caused by infection with the hepatitis E virus (HEV). It is transmitted via food or drink handled by an infected person or through infected water supplies in areas where fecal matter may get into the water. Hepatitis E does not cause chronic liver disease.
Hallmark Symptoms: joint pain, vomiting, fatigue, high fever, yellowish skin, dark urine, nausea, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, yellowing of eyes, acute liver failure, coma, stomach bleeding
Recommended Precautions & Management: stop alcohol consumption; rest; consult doctor; medication
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Hypertension.description: Hypertension (HTN or HT), also known as high blood pressure (HBP), is a long-term medical condition in which the blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated. High blood pressure typically does not cause symptoms.
Hypertension.search_content:
Disease: Hypertension
Medical Overview: Hypertension (HTN or HT), also known as high blood pressure (HBP), is a long-term medical condition in which the blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated. High blood pressure typically does not cause symptoms.
Hallmark Symptoms: headache, chest pain, dizziness, loss of balance, lack of concentration
Recommended Precautions & Management: meditation; salt baths; reduce stress; get proper sleep
Recommended Specialist: Cardiologist

Hyperthyroidism.description: Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid) occurs when your thyroid gland produces too much of the hormone thyroxine. Hyperthyroidism can accelerate your body's metabolism, causing unintentional weight loss and a rapid or irregular heartbeat.
Hyperthyroidism.search_content:
Disease: Hyperthyroidism
Medical Overview: Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid) occurs when your thyroid gland produces too much of the hormone thyroxine. Hyperthyroidism can accelerate your body's metabolism, causing unintentional weight loss and a rapid or irregular heartbeat.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, mood swings, weight loss, restlessness, sweating, diarrhoea, fast heart rate, excessive hunger, muscle weakness, irritability, abnormal menstruation
Recommended Precautions & Management: eat healthy; massage; use lemon balm; take radioactive iodine treatment
Recommended Specialist: Endocrinologist

Hypoglycemia.description: Hypoglycemia is a condition in which your blood sugar (glucose) level is lower than normal. Glucose is your body's main energy source. Hypoglycemia is often related to diabetes treatment. But other drugs and a variety of conditions — many rare — can cause low blood sugar in people who don't have diabetes.
Hypoglycemia.search_content:
Disease: Hypoglycemia
Medical Overview: Hypoglycemia is a condition in which your blood sugar (glucose) level is lower than normal. Glucose is your body's main energy source. Hypoglycemia is often related to diabetes treatment. But other drugs and a variety of conditions — many rare — can cause low blood sugar in people who don't have diabetes.
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, fatigue, anxiety, sweating, headache, nausea, blurred and distorted vision, excessive hunger, drying and tingling lips, slurred speech, irritability, palpitations
Recommended Precautions & Management: lie down on side; check in pulse; drink sugary drinks; consult doctor
Recommended Specialist: Endocrinologist

Hypothyroidism.description: Hypothyroidism, also called underactive thyroid or low thyroid, is a disorder of the endocrine system in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone.
Hypothyroidism.search_content:
Disease: Hypothyroidism
Medical Overview: Hypothyroidism, also called underactive thyroid or low thyroid, is a disorder of the endocrine system in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, weight gain, cold hands and feets, mood swings, lethargy, dizziness, puffy face and eyes, enlarged thyroid, brittle nails, swollen extremeties, depression, irritability, abnormal menstruation
Recommended Precautions & Management: reduce stress; exercise; eat healthy; get proper sleep
Recommended Specialist: Endocrinologist

Impetigo.description: Impetigo (im-puh-TIE-go) is a common and highly contagious skin infection that mainly affects infants and children. Impetigo usually appears as red sores on the face, especially around a child's nose and mouth, and on hands and feet. The sores burst and develop honey-colored crusts.
precautions: soak affected area in warm water
remove scabs with wet compressed cloth
Impetigo.search_content:
Disease: Impetigo
Medical Overview: Impetigo (im-puh-TIE-go) is a common and highly contagious skin infection that mainly affects infants and children. Impetigo usually appears as red sores on the face, especially around a child's nose and mouth, and on hands and feet. The sores burst and develop honey-colored crusts.
Hallmark Symptoms: skin rash, high fever, blister, red sore around nose, yellow crust ooze
Recommended Precautions & Management: soak affected area in warm water; use antibiotics; remove scabs with wet compressed cloth; consult doctor
Recommended Specialist: Dermatologist

Jaundice.description: Yellow staining of the skin and sclerae (the whites of the eyes) by abnormally high blood levels of the bile pigment bilirubin. The yellowing extends to other tissues and body fluids. Jaundice was once called the "morbus regius" (the regal disease) in the belief that only the touch of a king could cure it
precautions: eat fruits and high fiberous food
Jaundice.search_content:
Disease: Jaundice
Medical Overview: Yellow staining of the skin and sclerae (the whites of the eyes) by abnormally high blood levels of the bile pigment bilirubin. The yellowing extends to other tissues and body fluids. Jaundice was once called the "morbus regius" (the regal disease) in the belief that only the touch of a king could cure it
Hallmark Symptoms: itching, vomiting, fatigue, weight loss, high fever, yellowish skin, dark urine, abdominal pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: drink plenty of water; consume milk thistle; eat fruits and high fiberous food; medication
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist / Hepatologist

Malaria.description: An infectious disease caused by protozoan parasites from the Plasmodium family that can be transmitted by the bite of the Anopheles mosquito or by a contaminated needle or transfusion. Falciparum malaria is the most deadly type.
Malaria.search_content:
Disease: Malaria
Medical Overview: An infectious disease caused by protozoan parasites from the Plasmodium family that can be transmitted by the bite of the Anopheles mosquito or by a contaminated needle or transfusion. Falciparum malaria is the most deadly type.
Hallmark Symptoms: chills, vomiting, high fever, sweating, headache, nausea, diarrhoea, muscle pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: Consult nearest hospital; avoid oily food; avoid non veg food; keep mosquitos out
Recommended Specialist: Infectious Disease Specialist

Migraine.description: A migraine can cause severe throbbing pain or a pulsing sensation, usually on one side of the head. It's often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and extreme sensitivity to light and sound. Migraine attacks can last for hours to days, and the pain can be so severe that it interferes with your daily activities.
Migraine.search_content:
Disease: Migraine
Medical Overview: A migraine can cause severe throbbing pain or a pulsing sensation, usually on one side of the head. It's often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and extreme sensitivity to light and sound. Migraine attacks can last for hours to days, and the pain can be so severe that it interferes with your daily activities.
Hallmark Symptoms: acidity, indigestion, headache, blurred and distorted vision, excessive hunger, stiff neck, depression, irritability, visual disturbances
Recommended Precautions & Management: meditation; reduce stress; use poloroid glasses in sun; consult doctor
Recommended Specialist: Neurologist

Osteoarthritis.description: Osteoarthritis is the most common form of arthritis, affecting millions of people worldwide. It occurs when the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of your bones wears down over time.
Osteoarthritis.search_content:
Disease: Osteoarthritis
Medical Overview: Osteoarthritis is the most common form of arthritis, affecting millions of people worldwide. It occurs when the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of your bones wears down over time.
Hallmark Symptoms: joint pain, neck pain, knee pain, hip joint pain, swelling joints, painful walking
Recommended Precautions & Management: acetaminophen; consult nearest hospital; follow up; salt baths
Recommended Specialist: Rheumatologist / Orthopedist

Paralysis (Brain Hemorrhage).description: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) is when blood suddenly bursts into brain tissue, causing damage to your brain. Symptoms usually appear suddenly during ICH. They include headache, weakness, confusion, and paralysis, particularly on one side of your body.
Paralysis (Brain Hemorrhage).search_content:
Disease: Paralysis (Brain Hemorrhage)
Medical Overview: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) is when blood suddenly bursts into brain tissue, causing damage to your brain. Symptoms usually appear suddenly during ICH. They include headache, weakness, confusion, and paralysis, particularly on one side of your body.
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, headache, weakness of one body side, altered sensorium
Recommended Precautions & Management: massage; eat healthy; exercise; consult doctor
Recommended Specialist: Neurologist

Peptic ulcer disease.description: Peptic ulcer disease (PUD) is a break in the inner lining of the stomach, the first part of the small intestine, or sometimes the lower esophagus. An ulcer in the stomach is called a gastric ulcer, while one in the first part of the intestines is a duodenal ulcer.
Peptic ulcer disease.search_content:
Disease: Peptic ulcer disease
Medical Overview: Peptic ulcer disease (PUD) is a break in the inner lining of the stomach, the first part of the small intestine, or sometimes the lower esophagus. An ulcer in the stomach is called a gastric ulcer, while one in the first part of the intestines is a duodenal ulcer.
Hallmark Symptoms: vomiting, indigestion, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, passage of gases, internal itching
Recommended Precautions & Management: avoid fatty spicy food; consume probiotic food; eliminate milk; limit alcohol
Recommended Specialist: Gastroenterologist

Pneumonia.description: Pneumonia is an infection in one or both lungs. Bacteria, viruses, and fungi cause it. The infection causes inflammation in the air sacs in your lungs, which are called alveoli. The alveoli fill with fluid or pus, making it difficult to breathe.
Pneumonia.search_content:
Disease: Pneumonia
Medical Overview: Pneumonia is an infection in one or both lungs. Bacteria, viruses, and fungi cause it. The infection causes inflammation in the air sacs in your lungs, which are called alveoli. The alveoli fill with fluid or pus, making it difficult to breathe.
Hallmark Symptoms: chills, fatigue, cough, high fever, breathlessness, sweating, malaise, phlegm, chest pain, fast heart rate, rusty sputum
Recommended Precautions & Management: consult doctor; medication; rest; follow up
Recommended Specialist: Pulmonologist

Psoriasis.description: Psoriasis is a common skin disorder that forms thick, red, bumpy patches covered with silvery scales. They can pop up anywhere, but most appear on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Psoriasis can't be passed from person to person. It does sometimes happen in members of the same family.
precautions: wash hands with warm soapy water
Psoriasis.search_content:
Disease: Psoriasis
Medical Overview: Psoriasis is a common skin disorder that forms thick, red, bumpy patches covered with silvery scales. They can pop up anywhere, but most appear on the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Psoriasis can't be passed from person to person. It does sometimes happen in members of the same family.
Hallmark Symptoms: skin rash, joint pain, skin peeling, silver like dusting, small dents in nails, inflammatory nails
Recommended Precautions & Management: wash hands with warm soapy water; stop bleeding using pressure; consult doctor; salt baths
Recommended Specialist: Dermatologist

Tuberculosis.description: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease usually caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) bacteria. Tuberculosis generally affects the lungs, but can also affect other parts of the body. Most infections show no symptoms, in which case it is known as latent tuberculosis.
Tuberculosis.search_content:
Disease: Tuberculosis
Medical Overview: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease usually caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) bacteria. Tuberculosis generally affects the lungs, but can also affect other parts of the body. Most infections show no symptoms, in which case it is known as latent tuberculosis.
Hallmark Symptoms: chills, vomiting, fatigue, weight loss, cough, high fever, breathlessness, sweating, loss of appetite, mild fever, yellowing of eyes, swelled lymph nodes, malaise, phlegm, chest pain, blood in sputum
Recommended Precautions & Management: cover mouth; consult doctor; medication; rest
Recommended Specialist: Pulmonologist

Typhoid.description: An acute illness characterized by fever caused by infection with the bacterium Salmonella typhi. Typhoid fever has an insidious onset, with fever, headache, constipation, malaise, chills, and muscle pain. Diarrhea is uncommon, and vomiting is not usually severe.
Typhoid.search_content:
Disease: Typhoid
Medical Overview: An acute illness characterized by fever caused by infection with the bacterium Salmonella typhi. Typhoid fever has an insidious onset, with fever, headache, constipation, malaise, chills, and muscle pain. Diarrhea is uncommon, and vomiting is not usually severe.
Hallmark Symptoms: chills, vomiting, fatigue, high fever, headache, nausea, constipation, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, toxic look (typhos), belly pain
Recommended Precautions & Management: eat high calorie vegitables; antiboitic therapy; consult doctor; medication
Recommended Specialist: General Physician

Urinary Tract Infection.description: Urinary tract infection: An infection of the kidney, ureter, bladder, or urethra. Abbreviated UTI. Not everyone with a UTI has symptoms, but common symptoms include a frequent urge to urinate and pain or burning when urinating.
Urinary Tract Infection.search_content:
Disease: Urinary Tract Infection
Medical Overview: Urinary tract infection: An infection of the kidney, ureter, bladder, or urethra. Abbreviated UTI. Not everyone with a UTI has symptoms, but common symptoms include a frequent urge to urinate and pain or burning when urinating.
Hallmark Symptoms: burning micturition, bladder discomfort, foul smell of urine, continuous feel of urine
Recommended Precautions & Management: drink plenty of water; increase vitamin c intake; drink cranberry juice; take probiotics
Recommended Specialist: Urologist / General Physician

Varicose Veins.description: A vein that has enlarged and twisted, often appearing as a bulging, blue blood vessel that is clearly visible through the skin. Varicose veins are most common in older adults, particularly women, and occur especially on the legs.
precautions: lie down flat and raise the leg high
Varicose Veins.search_content:
Disease: Varicose Veins
Medical Overview: A vein that has enlarged and twisted, often appearing as a bulging, blue blood vessel that is clearly visible through the skin. Varicose veins are most common in older adults, particularly women, and occur especially on the legs.
Hallmark Symptoms: fatigue, cramps, bruising, obesity, swollen legs, swollen blood vessels, prominent veins on calf
Recommended Precautions & Management: lie down flat and raise the leg high; use oinments; use vein compression; dont stand still for long
Recommended Specialist: Vascular Surgeon
